committee: * Present Certificate 281-38 (COR) - Senator Joe S. San Agustin
title: Hafa Adai Senators, Media and Stakeholders! Please join Senator Joe S. San Agustin as he presents Legislative Certificate 281-38 on Saturday, January 17, 2026, 7pm at Good Company in Hagatna. Certificate 281 is relative to recognizing Mr. Franklin E. Cruz on his retirement after 44 years of dedicated service at the US Fuel Facilities with Joint Region Marianas. Your attendance and participation will enhance the celebration of service to our island and country, and is greatly appreciated. Please contact the office should you have any questions.
